pages.text: iron's spells 'n spellbooks mostly comes to you as loot - scrolls and spellbooks out in dungeons and ruins. bring them home and check their uses in jei.$(br2)try a new spell somewhere quiet before taking it into a dungeon. check its range, mana cost, and cooldown so you know what you're carrying.$(br2)you can use both magic systems. there's no paperwork.
